<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Combined process for organizing accommodation and a bank account and for applying for a visa (Rot-Weiss-Rot Card). The visa must be renewed every x months; the interval is not specified in the description and is therefore not modeled as a timer.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_WorkLiveAustria">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Parallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Negotiate_Accommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Negotiate_Bank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Check_Requirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Category_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Prepare_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Provide_Additional_Docs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Parallel_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Representation" name="Austrian representation office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_MainDest_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Competence_Main_Destination</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Competence_First_Entry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_MainDest_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Verify_Consular_District</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Competence_Type_D</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Competence_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Review_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Complete_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Request_Additional_Docs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Decision_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Issue_Visa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Notify_Refusal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_Decision_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Process" name="Plan work and stay in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Parallel_Split" name="Start parallel arrangements"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Negotiate_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Negotiate_Bank" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Check_Requirements" name="Check visa requirements and contact representation in advance"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Category_Split" name="Visa category?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_MainDest_Split" name="Main travel destination determinable?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Competence_Main_Destination" name="Determine representation of main travel destination">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visas are issued by the representation of the country where the main travel destination is located.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Competence_First_Entry" name="Determine representation of first Schengen entry member state">
      <bpmn:documentation>If no main travel destination can be determined, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_MainDest_Join" name="Competent representation determined"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Verify_Consular_District" name="Verify consular district of legal place of residence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Territorial competence for category A and C visas lies with the representation in the consular district of the legal place of residence. Exceptional competence may be claimed with justification.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Competence_Type_D" name="Determine competent Austrian representation by place of residence (Section 8 FPG)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation, based on the centre of interest (e.g. registration forms, residence permit, visa).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Competence_Join" name="Competence determined"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Prepare_Application" name="Prepare visa application">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SP_Start" name="Preparation started"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="SP_Split" name="Prepare all required items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Form" name="Complete visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Travel_Document" name="Provide travel document valid in Austria">
        <bpmn:documentation>Validity exceeds the visa duration by at least three months, at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Photo" name="Provide passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Insurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive policy for the planned duration of stay, cover of 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Means" name="Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence">
        <bpmn:documentation>Covers the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="SP_Task_Other_Evidence" name="Provide other requested evidence">
        <bpmn:documentation>For example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment; requirements may vary by location and additional documents may be requested.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="SP_Join" name="All items prepared"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SP_End" name="Application documents prepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_1" sourceRef="SP_Start" targetRef="SP_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_2" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Form"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_3" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Travel_Document"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_4" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Photo"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_5" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_6" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Means"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_7" sourceRef="SP_Split" targetRef="SP_Task_Other_Evidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_8" sourceRef="SP_Task_Form" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_9" sourceRef="SP_Task_Travel_Document" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_10" sourceRef="SP_Task_Photo" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_11" sourceRef="SP_Task_Insurance" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_12" sourceRef="SP_Task_Means" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_13" sourceRef="SP_Task_Other_Evidence" targetRef="SP_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_14" sourceRef="SP_Join" targetRef="SP_End"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit_Application" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Review_Join" name="Application received or additional documents provided"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Review_Application" name="Review application and check absence of other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other grounds for refusal include residence prohibition and alerts issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Complete_Split" name="Application complete?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Request_Additional_Docs" name="Request additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Provide_Additional_Docs" name="Provide additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Decision_Split" name="Visa decision"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Issue_Visa" name="Issue Rot-Weiss-Rot visa"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Notify_Refusal" name="Notify visa refusal"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Decision_Join" name="Visa decision recorded"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Parallel_Join" name="Accommodation, bank account and visa process finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Work and living arrangements completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Process" targetRef="GW_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="GW_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_Negotiate_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="GW_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_Negotiate_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="GW_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_Check_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate_Accommodation" targetRef="GW_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate_Bank" targetRef="GW_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_Check_Requirements" targetRef="GW_Category_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="GW_Category_Split" targetRef="GW_MainDest_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Type D" sourceRef="GW_Category_Split" targetRef="Task_Competence_Type_D"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_MainDest_Split" targetRef="Task_Competence_Main_Destination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No" sourceRef="GW_MainDest_Split" targetRef="Task_Competence_First_Entry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_Competence_Main_Destination" targetRef="GW_MainDest_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Competence_First_Entry" targetRef="GW_MainDest_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="GW_MainDest_Join" targetRef="Task_Verify_Consular_District"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_Verify_Consular_District" targetRef="GW_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Competence_Type_D" targetRef="GW_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="GW_Competence_Join" targetRef="SubProcess_Prepare_Application"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SubProcess_Prepare_Application" targetRef="Task_Submit_Application"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_Submit_Application" targetRef="GW_Review_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="GW_Review_Join" targetRef="Task_Review_Application"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_Review_Application" targetRef="GW_Complete_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Complete_Split" targetRef="Task_Request_Additional_Docs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Complete_Split" targetRef="GW_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_Request_Additional_Docs" targetRef="Task_Provide_Additional_Docs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_Provide_Additional_Docs" targetRef="GW_Review_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" name="Granted" sourceRef="GW_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Issue_Visa"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" name="Refused" sourceRef="GW_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Notify_Refusal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_Issue_Visa" targetRef="GW_Decision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_Notify_Refusal" targetRef="GW_Decision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="GW_Decision_Join" targetRef="GW_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="GW_Parallel_Join" targetRef="End_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_MainDest_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Verify_Consular_District</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Competence_Type_D</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Decision_Join" name="Visa decision recorded"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_Parallel_Join" name="Accommodation, bank account and visa process finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Work and living arrangements completed"/>

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that a person performs by hand outside any software, such as searching, negotiating, signing, preparing or gathering, and each is stated as its own step in the sequence: Model each such hand-performed activity as its own bpmn:manualTask, in the order the description states it, on the branch where the description places it, connected by sequence flows. Do not omit these steps or fold several of them into one task.
rules.situation: the description names several activities that a person performs by hand outside any software, such as searching, negotiating, signing, preparing or gathering, and each is stated as its own step in the sequence

rules.instruction: When the description lists, among several requirements, a condition on the remaining term or the issue age of an identity travel credential, or on its number of blank pages, that the applicant must satisfy before the application can proceed: Model that condition as its own task whose label names the check (for instance, check that the credential's remaining term is sufficient), placed in the order the list gives and before the gateway that asks whether the application is complete. Keep it separate from the other requirement checks and do not merge it into a general requirements check, even when the description does not state the check's result.
rules.situation: the description lists, among several requirements, a condition on the remaining term or the issue age of an identity travel credential, or on its number of blank pages, that the applicant must satisfy before the application can proceed

rules.instruction: When the description lists several applicant categories or permit types, each with its own set of requirements that must be checked before a common step: Model one manual requirement-check task per listed category, placed on that category's branch of a gateway that selects the applicable category. Join the branches before the next common step. Do not merge the category-specific checks into one generic check, and do not omit a listed category.
rules.situation: the description lists several applicant categories or permit types, each with its own set of requirements that must be checked before a common step

rules.instruction: When the description enumerates several separate conditions or required items that must each be satisfied before a later decision or completeness check, and it lists them individually: Model a separate verification task for each enumerated condition or item, each connected in sequence before the gateway that makes the decision. Do not replace the individual checks with one combined check task, and do not omit a listed item because the description does not name a separate result for it.
rules.situation: the description enumerates several separate conditions or required items that must each be satisfied before a later decision or completeness check, and it lists them individually
